The Gregorian year 2025 corresponds to the Berber (Amazigh) year 2975 [d1][d6]. This is based on the Berber calendar's starting point of 950 BC, the approximate date of the ascent of Libyan King Sheshonq I to the throne of Egypt, as adopted by the Académie Berbère of Paris [d1][d2]. Older sources from 2021 had stated that the Berber year was 2971 for Gregorian 2021 [d4][d5], and a 2023 source noted that 2974 corresponded to 2024 [d8], all of which are now superseded by the current correspondence of 2975 to 2025 [d1][d6]. The Berber New Year (Yennayer) marking the start of year 2975 is celebrated on January 12th in Algeria and January 13th in Morocco [d3][d7].
